generic_patterns.label: em dash
generic_patterns.advice: Replace with a full stop, comma, colon or parentheses.

generic_patterns.label: negative parallelism (not just X but Y)
generic_patterns.advice: State the positive claim directly and drop the setup clause.

generic_patterns.label: antithesis (It is not X. It is Y)
generic_patterns.advice: Humans rarely speak in constant opposites. Make the claim once.

generic_patterns.label: formal connectives (Furthermore/Moreover/Additionally)
generic_patterns.advice: Use 'also', 'but', 'so', or start a new sentence.

generic_patterns.label: summary connectives (In summary/Overall/Ultimately)
generic_patterns.advice: Cut. If the paragraph is a summary the reader can tell.

generic_patterns.label: LLM vocabulary (delve/leverage/robust/underscore)
generic_patterns.advice: Swap for plain words: dig into, use, strong, show, use.

generic_patterns.label: puffery (pivotal/crucial/vital/testament/remarkable)
generic_patterns.advice: Usually deletable. If the point matters, the evidence shows it.

generic_patterns.label: hedge preamble (It is important to note)
generic_patterns.advice: Delete the preamble and keep the point.

generic_patterns.label: rule of three in a sentence (A, B and C)
generic_patterns.advice: Check each one: is it a real list, or three items invented for rhythm?

Claude.label: genuine / genuinely
Claude.advice: Claude writes this ~10x more than other models. Cut or use 'real'.

Claude.label: it is worth noting
Claude.advice: People rarely announce that something is worth noticing.

Claude.label: rhetorical questions
Claude.advice: Claude asks ~3.9 per 1,000 words. In a report, convert to statements.

ChatGPT.label: because-chaining
ChatGPT.advice: ChatGPT hooks clauses with 'because' at ~6.5 per 1,000 words.

Gemini.label: intensifiers (incredibly/highly/massive/vital)
Gemini.advice: Gemini leads on booster words at ~6.1 per 1,000.

Gemini.label: uncontracted formality (it is / we must / do not)
